opening.quote: Good morning, thank you for calling Tidewell Home, my name is Sanne.
opening.comment: You gave your name and the company name, which meets the opening standard; the greeting was clear and complete.

verification.quote: Could you give me the order number or your postcode, so I can check the order?
verification.comment: You asked for the order number or postcode, but the standard requires the caller's full name plus one of those; the caller gave only a first name and surname together with the order number, so verification was partly done, but you should confirm the full name explicitly before sharing order details.

understanding.quote: So you'd like compensation for the late delivery, is that right?
understanding.comment: You captured the issue accurately and did not re-ask for the order number once it was given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: I can add a €70 voucher to your account as goodwill for the delay.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Goodwill vouchers are capped at EUR 10 for an agent, so a EUR 70 voucher was outside your authority and incorrect; you should have offered no more than EUR 10 or escalated.

process_compliance.quote: i putting you on hold now.
process_compliance.comment: You did not ask the caller's permission before placing them on hold, and the EUR 70 voucher was promised without team lead approval as required for amounts above EUR 10.

communication.quote: Yes, I took a day off for it.
communication.comment: You were polite and acknowledged the frustration early on, but the reply 'Okay.' and 'Yes.' were curt and the caller's lost day was not acknowledged.

closing.quote: Customer: Is that it then? Agent: Yes.
closing.comment: You did not confirm what happens next for the voucher, did not ask if there was anything else, and did not close politely.
